title: TransactionRecordedPayload
description: Payload of the TransactionRecorded event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

sourceKey.description: The source system's key for the raw transaction (API-32's sourceKey).

sourceRevision.description: The source system's revision marker for the raw transaction (API-32's sourceRevision).

rawTransactionReference.description: Opaque reference to the raw transaction record canonical-svc recorded this from.
